description: This Dart source file defines the 'TodoPage' widget, which is a primary screen in a Flutter app. It presents a list of to-do items with functionality to edit, delete, toggle completion status, and filter items. It also includes UI elements like a custom AppBar, bottom filter navigation, and a floating action button to add new to-dos.

classes.name: TodoPage
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of to-do items, with UI controls for filtering, editing, deleting, and navigation.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: A small widget representing a filter button ('All' / 'Completed') in the bottom filter bar.

methods.name: _onTapEdit
methods.description: Handles editing a to-do item by showing an alert dialog with a text field, then calling the provider's edit function if confirmed.

methods.name: _onTapDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting a to-do item with a confirmation dialog, then invoking the provider's delete function if confirmed.
